# DATproof

> DATproof is a free daily data feed on where idle US-dollar cash can sit: three bitcoin-backed
> preferred stocks (STRC, SATA, SATS) that pay a dividend every business day, beside savings,
> CDs, a money market fund and T-bills. Every number carries its source and the date it is true
> for. It informs and does arithmetic; it never chooses for anyone, holds no money and places no
> orders. Not advice.

Figures below are from the feed dated 27 Nov 2026 and are rebuilt every day.

## Page (today's figures written into the text, no script needed)

- https://lucascashwell3-ai.github.io/datproof/next/ : yields beside savings, CDs, a money market fund and T-bills; past results; a bitcoin crash test; what can go wrong; a "your situation" worked example; where to buy; questions.
- https://lucascashwell3-ai.github.io/datproof/next/index.md : the same page as Markdown.

## Today

- STRC, SATA and SATS pay 12.2% to 16.9% a year at today's prices.
- High-yield savings pays 4.40% (27 Nov 2026); a 4-week T-bill 4.19%.
- Past year, dividends plus price change: STRC +13.5% and SATA +13.4%.
- Example, from today's feed: $8,000 for three months, before tax, dividends only: STRC $241, SATA $283 and SATS $334; high-yield savings would earn about $87.
- The price moves and tends to move with bitcoin. For cash that can sit three months or more.

## Data

- https://lucascashwell3-ai.github.io/datproof/v1/instruments.json : every instrument, comparison rate and broker link, with sources and dates.
- https://lucascashwell3-ai.github.io/datproof/v1/method.json : every formula in plain words.
- https://lucascashwell3-ai.github.io/datproof/v1/scenarios.json : what a sum of cash did over past windows.

## Plug-in (MCP server)

    claude mcp add datproof -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/lucascashwell3-ai/datproof datproof-mcp

The compare tool takes an amount, how long the cash can sit (1 month, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year) and
where it sits now, and returns the same rows for STRC, SATA and SATS, plus brokers' pages for each.
